minor_findings.summary: A few Unicode presentation glyphs are normalized.
minor_findings.evidence: The source title uses em dashes and the source yield and custards label use fullwidth ６; the candidate uses en dashes and ASCII 6 in those positions. The represented words, numbers, and cooking meaning are unchanged.

rationale: All multilingual ingredient evidence, setup actions, operation memberships, dependencies, controls, completion criteria, and final output survive. The only differences are typographic Unicode substitutions and a faithful split of the coffee preparation state from its label.
